optimized_sql:
SELECT i.i_item_id, s.s_state, grouping(s.s_state) AS g_state,
       CASE WHEN SUM(a.cnt_quantity) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(a.sum_quantity)::numeric / SUM(a.cnt_quantity)::numeric END AS agg1,
       CASE WHEN SUM(a.cnt_list_price) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(a.sum_list_price)::numeric / SUM(a.cnt_list_price)::numeric END AS agg2,
       CASE WHEN SUM(a.cnt_coupon_amt) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(a.sum_coupon_amt)::numeric / SUM(a.cnt_coupon_amt)::numeric END AS agg3,
       CASE WHEN SUM(a.cnt_sales_price) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(a.sum_sales_price)::numeric / SUM(a.cnt_sales_price)::numeric END AS agg4
FROM (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sum_quantity,
           COUNT(ss.ss_quantity) AS cnt_quantity,
           SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS sum_list_price,
           COUNT(ss.ss_list_price) AS cnt_list_price,
           SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_coupon_amt,
           COUNT(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_coupon_amt,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales_price,
           COUNT(ss.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_sales_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    WHERE ss.ss_cdemo_sk IN (
            SELECT cd_demo_sk
            FROM customer_demographics
            WHERE cd_gender = 'M'
              AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
              AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
        )
      AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk IN (
            SELECT d_date_sk
            FROM date_dim
            WHERE d_year = 1999
        )
      AND ss.ss_store_sk IN (
            SELECT s_store_sk
            FROM store
            WHERE s_state = 'TN'
        )
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk
) AS a
JOIN item i ON a.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN store s ON a.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND s.s_state = 'TN'
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, s.s_state)
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, s.s_state
LIMIT 100
